en-US.description: All-in-one command and control platform for BCC2000 & BCC2000 Plus cameras.
en-US.longDescription: Brinno Command Center is an all-in-one command and control platform for BCC2000 & BCC2000 Plus cameras that allows you to access your camera through your laptop via the Camera Extender Kit (AFB1000). Use the platform to do a wide variety of actions including: preview camera frame, change settings, check battery and SD card status. All from the comfort of your laptop!
en-US.name: Brinno Connect

zh-CN.description: BCC2000 和 BCC2000 Plus 摄像机的一体化指挥和控制平台。
zh-CN.longDescription: Brinno Command Center 是 BCC2000 和 BCC2000 Plus 摄像机的一体化指挥和控制平台，允许您借助摄像机扩展器套件（AFB1000）通过笔记本电脑访问摄像机。使用该平台可执行各种操作，包括：预览摄像机画面、更改设置、检查电池和 SD 卡状态。所有这些操作都可以在笔记本电脑上轻松完成！
